svg.aria-label: From just release to the stores. just release sets APP_VERSION to today's date and next revision, commits on origin/master, tags vYYYY.M.D-build.REVISION and pushes to both remotes. The tag on GitHub runs release.yml, which rejects a mismatched tag and publishes the GitHub release with the packages and Orchard OCI files. just publish waits for it, then you approve seven NIP-46 signing requests in your bunker. One NIP-82 release goes to four relays, for Zapstore and Orchard; a tag push alone adds nothing to Orchard.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace
